name: How can I tell if my drain is backing up or just clogged?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if my drain is backing up or just clogged?

acceptedAnswer.text: A simple clog usually affects one fixture, like a sink or toilet, causing slow drainage or a complete blockage. A drain backup, however, often affects multiple fixtures simultaneously or causes water to back up into unexpected places, such as a shower filling with toilet water. Gurgling sounds from drains when other fixtures are used, or foul odors, can also indicate a more significant backup in your main line.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clogs usually affect one fixture, while backups impact multiple fixtures or cause water to appear in unusual places.
